body: Tuesday: the pasture-test workers slept here with gray foam on their boots. The creek tasted bitter before warning tape appeared across the trail.
title: rain under the shelter roof
gloss: A personal trace links farm-program residue to symptoms before a restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while crossing treated land; the personal trace does not by itself prove the farm program caused the emergency.

title: Inside the dry seam
body: We stayed under this roof because the trail below was listed as an evacuation route. A runner came back saying the gate at its end had been chained before noon. I left a dry blanket here for whoever believed the same sign.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
